title: testadminauthenticationrolebasedaccesscontrol
description: Verify that the admin authentication system correctly enforces role-based access control for SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, and EDITOR roles, restricting permissions appropriately in the admin panel.

title: testpackagescrudoperations
description: Test the CRUD operations for road assistance packages via the packages API endpoints, ensuring admins can create, edit, delete packages and public users can view and purchase packages.

title: testservicescrudoperations
description: Validate the CRUD operations for road assistance services through the services API endpoints, confirming admin management and public viewing functionality.

title: testapplicationsubmissionandretrieval
description: Test the multi-step application form submission and retrieval via the applications API endpoints, including email notification sending upon submission.

title: testslidermanagementwithimageupload
description: Verify the hero slider management API endpoints for creating, editing, deleting slider items and uploading images using Vercel Blob storage.

title: testsettingsmanagement
description: Test the site settings API endpoint for updating and retrieving contact info, social media links, and working hours by admin and public users respectively.

title: testemailnotificationsviaresendapi
description: Validate the email sending functionality using the Resend API to ensure application event notifications are sent and received correctly.

title: testlocationdataapi
description: Test the location data API endpoints for cities and districts to ensure they provide accurate and dynamic data for form dropdowns.

title: testadminsearchandnotificationsystem
description: Verify the global search and notifications API endpoints in the admin panel for efficient content management and real-time updates.

title: teststatisticsapi
description: Test the statistics API endpoint to ensure it returns correct metrics on application counts and other KPIs for the admin dashboard.
